contentText: Football club Paris Saint-Germain lifted the Ligue 1 trophy but then lost 2-1 away to neighbours Paris FC in their last game before the Champions League final against Arsenal. There were plenty of surprises during the French football competition - some bad ones for PSG and some good ones for Marseille. In total, six French clubs will be playing in European competitions next year, like Lens in the Champions League and Rennes in the Conference League.
